verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's docs make OpenAI API compatibility a first-party capability: point the existing OpenAI SDK at its base URL, then change only the API key and model name. That gives developers a vendor-endorsed SDK path, but no DeepInfra-maintained SDK is evidenced, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec for generating clients. Missing for 10: a first-party DeepInfra SDK, SDK reference docs or language coverage, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of drop-in SDK use.
